changes_made.explanation: Added 'Dialogue State Tracking' as the main task since the paper focuses on DST specifically. Added all comparison models mentioned in the paper for completeness. The paper involves generation of slot values, which qualifies as NLG.
Normalized metric names to standard capitalization. These are the only automatic metrics used for evaluating the generated dialogue states.
No LLM-based evaluation methods are used in this 2020 paper. LLM-as-judge approaches became popular later.
The paper only uses automatic evaluation metrics (joint goal accuracy) and does not mention any human evaluation.

overall_notes: This is a 2020 dialogue state tracking paper that proposes SOM-DST model. The paper focuses on efficiently generating dialogue state slot-value pairs using a selective overwriting mechanism. It uses standard automatic evaluation metrics (joint goal accuracy) but no human or LLM-based evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some comparison models mentioned in the paper.
